subject: Updates to Google Play Terms of Service
body_text:
On November 5, 2026, we’re making some changes to our Google Play Terms of Service. These changes won’t affect the way you use Google Play, but they should help make it easier for you to understand what to expect from Google Play — and what we expect from you — as you use our services.
You can review the new terms here . At a glance, here’s what this update means for you:
•
Applicable Terms: We updated the definition of Content in the terms to make clear that it includes system services (including, but not limited to, those provided by Google Play services ).
If you use Family Link to manage a Google Account for someone else, please take some time to talk to them about these changes.
By continuing to use Google Play after these changes, you agree to the new terms. If you do not agree, you may download content you previously purchased or installed and terminate your use of Google Play.
Thank you for using Google Play!
